title: Build an Android Jetpack Compose field-work order screen using .sp text, edge-to-edge insets, and TalkBack semantics

contextSnapshot.surface: Android Jetpack Compose work-order checklist and status screen

prompt: Implement an Android Jetpack Compose work-order screen in Kotlin where technicians update job status offline, attach notes with the IME open, and read checklists cleanly at 200% Android system font scaling.
forbiddenBehaviors: specifies text fontSize in .dp instead of .sp, breaking Android font scaling
omits imePadding() / navigationBarsPadding() so the software keyboard covers the submit bar
hardcodes ARGB Color(0xFF...) hex literals instead of MaterialTheme.colorScheme tokens
ignores TalkBack semantics or ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE reduced-motion checks

rubricDimensions.pass: uses .sp / MaterialTheme.typography for all text, avoids fixed-dp heights on text containers, and applies Scaffold innerPadding plus imePadding()
rubricDimensions.fail: uses .dp font sizes or clips text and submit actions behind system bars or keyboard

rubricDimensions.pass: models queued/error/retry states with explicit non-color badges, 48dp touch targets, and merged Semantics descriptions
rubricDimensions.fail: shows a permanent spinner offline or relies on color dots without contentDescription

rubricDimensions.pass: separates static Gradle/Compose inspection from rendered emulator/Compose UI test verification
rubricDimensions.fail: claims emulator TalkBack or 200% font scale passed without running instrumented UI checks

negativeControls.name: gradle assembleDebug only
negativeControls.mustNot: claim edge-to-edge insets, IME clearance, or TalkBack order are rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: hardcodes .dp text and fixed row heights, ignores edge-to-edge IME insets, and omits offline queue recovery states
baseline.withSkill: delivers idiomatic Kotlin Compose using MaterialTheme tokens, .sp scaling, edge-to-edge WindowInsets, explicit offline states, and honest evidence labels
